# Teleportation_Based_Interconnect

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
An interconnect architecture that uses quantum teleportation protocols to transfer information between nodes, relying on pre-shared entanglement and classical communication. This enables low-latency, high-fidelity communication in iNEST systems, potentially replacing traditional electrical interconnects with quantum-enhanced links.
